protocol_metadata.about: Unitas is a yield-bearing stablecoin protocol operating on Solana and BSC. Users deposit collateral to mint USDu, an overcollateralized stablecoin soft-pegged to USD; the protocol immediately opens delta-neutral perpetual short positions (primarily via Jupiter Perps JLP) to generate market-neutral yield. Staking USDu mints sUSDu, a savings token whose exchange rate auto-compounds protocol revenue (trading fees, funding rates) at historical APRs of 8–15%. Governance is split between a Guardian Council (5/9 multisig) with emergency powers and the Unipay DAO for fee and collateral decisions.
